description: Visual state indicator. Variant drives color + animation. Pairs with status-message (textual) and notification-wc (action-bearing).

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: Built-in: live, recording, streaming, error, online, running, away, paused, busy, offline, stopped. Custom variants supported via CSS only.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: xs | sm | md (default) | lg — dot diameter scale

attributes.name: data-position
attributes.description: before (default) | after | only — dot position relative to label; "only" visually hides label

attributes.name: data-pulse
attributes.description: on | off — override the variant's default animation

attributes.name: data-live
attributes.description: Set to "off" to drop role="status"/aria-live (decorative use)

attributes.name: data-label-*
attributes.description: Visually hidden default label per variant, used when the element has no slot text (e.g. data-label-online="En ligne"). Defaults: the English variant name (Live, Recording, Streaming, Error, Online, Running, Away, Paused, Busy, Offline, Stopped); a custom variant falls back to its name.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Explicit name; with no slot text it is also used as the visually hidden label text

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Defaults to "status" unless the author sets role/aria-live or data-live="off"

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Reads and writes data-variant (null/empty removes it)

events.name: status-wc:change
events.description: Fires when data-variant mutates after upgrade (not for the initial value). detail: { variant, previousVariant }

cssProperties.name: --status-dot-ring
cssProperties.description: Dot ring colour (default: a darker shade of the dot colour in light mode, the dot colour in dark mode)
